text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor f-o-r-g-e-d f-a-l-s-e c-a-p-t-i-v-e b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s to f-r-a-m-e w-i-l-d-t-a-k-e-n r-e-p-t-i-l-e-s as l-e-g-a-l s-t-o-c-k and l-e-f-t m-u-d-d-l-e-d p-r-i-n-t-o-u-t-s in the w-o-r-k-s-p-a-c-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the b-i-o-l-o-g-i-c-a-l a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p
2) the actor c-o-m-p-i-l-e-d a l-i-e-d o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p c-h-a-i-n a-c-r-o-s-s d-o-z-e-n-s of d-a-t-e-s to f-a-k-e g-e-n-e-r-a-t-i-o-n-s of b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g and l-e-f-t a s-p-r-e-a-d-s-h-e-e-t o-f i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r-y t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r-s b-e-h-i-n-d w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-r-o-s-s-r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n o-f p-e-r-m-i-t n-u-m-b-e-r-s
3) the actor f-o-r-g-e-d r-e-s-t-o-r-a-t-i-o-n p-e-r-m-i-t-s and o-f-f-i-c-e-s t-a-m-p-s to i-m-i-t-a-t-e a g-o-v-e-r-n-m-e-n-t a-l-l-o-w-a-n-c-e and l-e-f-t b-l-u-r-r-y s-c-a-n-s in the a-r-c-h-i-v-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l r-e-g-i-s-t-r-y l-o-o-k-u-p
4) the actor p-u-b-l-i-s-h-e-d d-e-c-e-p-t-i-v-e o-n-l-i-n-e l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s with p-h-o-t-o-s of w-i-l-d t-y-p-e-s p-r-e-s-e-n-t-e-d as c-a-p-t-i-v-e b-r-e-d s-u-b-j-e-c-t-s and l-e-f-t a t-r-a-c-k-a-b-l-e p-u-b-l-i-c t-r-a-c-e in m-a-r-k-e-t-p-l-a-c-e m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-n-t-e-n-t m-o-d-e-r-a-t-i-o-n a-n-d l-a-w e-n-f-o-r-c-e-m-e-n-t r-e-v-i-e-w
5) the actor c-l-o-s-e-d the m-a-t-t-e-r and a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d the m-i-s-l-a-b-e-l-e-d f-i-l-e-s as i-f the e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e w-a-s l-e-g-a-l-l-y c-o-m-p-l-e-t-e-d and l-e-f-t a n-o-t-e d-e-s-c-r-i-b-i-n-g the i-n-t-e-n-t to d-e-c-e-i-v-e w-i-l-d-l-i-f-e o-f-f-i-c-e-r-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e a-u-d-i-t
